# BatteryDPP-Check — EU Battery Passport (Reg. (EU) 2023/1542) Validator

> Zero-dependency GitHub Action, Node.js 20/22+ CLI, and 100 % client-side EU Battery Passport JSON-LD Validator & GS1 Digital Link QR Builder for EU Batteries Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 77 & Annex XIII (mandatory 18 February 2027 for EV, LMT, and industrial > 2 kWh batteries).

## Free Tools & GitHub Marketplace

- [Browser-Side EU Battery Passport JSON-LD Validator & GS1 QR Builder](https://yannabadie.github.io/battery-dpp-check/): Runs 10 automated Annex XIII & GS1 Mod-10 checks completely client-side with zero upload.
- [GitHub Marketplace Action (`yannabadie/battery-dpp-check@v1.0.0`)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/batterydpp-check-eu-battery-passport-2023-1542-validator): CI validation for OEMs, EV/LMT manufacturers, and importers.
- [XML Sitemap](https://yannabadie.github.io/battery-dpp-check/sitemap.xml)
